recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core source work is needed for FHIR-17174 unless MedicationKnowledge is reintroduced to the active build and a future work-group decision changes its status modifier semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-17174 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request raised and applied for STU3. It asked to add isModifier to Medication.status and MedicationKnowledge.status, and the final resolution agreed that status on both resources should be a modifier.
initial_application: The Jira comment records historical application in SVN build revision 13825 on 2018-06-04. No current git commit explicitly tagged FHIR-17174 was found, but git commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 introduced the current Medication and MedicationKnowledge StructureDefinition XML files with status isModifier=true already present.
additional_context: Medication remains active in source/fhir.ini and its status element is modifier-marked. MedicationKnowledge was later removed from active resource/status/abbreviation build entries by git commit 5a4307d78b0209f61bbc68d582c1e190b3aaee5c; the retained source file still marks MedicationKnowledge.status as a modifier. Related MedicationKnowledge status and product-boundary decisions are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change is needed because the requested modifier flag is present on active Medication.status, and there is no current-build MedicationKnowledge correction to make; even the retained MedicationKnowledge source already has the requested flag.
